The '''Ultraviolent Offenders Containment''' was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] detention complex located in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ultraviolent Offenders Containment appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
